title: AWS D1.1/D1.1M:2025 Structural Welding Code — Steel (public preview figure list)
description: Public preview of the welding code naming new or revised welded-joint detailed drawings; figures cover maximum fillet weld size at edges and prequalified joint details, with Clause 10 covering tubular T-, Y- and K-connections. | Figures: Figure 4.7 — clarifying the maximum specified fillet weld size along edges (new in 2025); Figures 5.1 and 5.2 — prequalified joint details replaced with new drawings (2025); Figure 5.2 — joint details for partially penetrated groove welds (referenced in 2020 summary); Figure 5.4 — acceptable and unacceptable weld profiles for groove welds in butt, corner, T- and lap joints (2010 edition summary)
